function.name: get_market_price
function.description: Today's price of a food commodity at a named market

function.name: find_health_centre
function.description: The nearest health centre or hospital in a town

function.name: set_reminder
function.description: Set a reminder for the user at a given time

function.name: get_football_score
function.description: Latest match score for a football team

en: What is the price of rice at Kano market today?
Where is the nearest health centre in Ibadan?
Remind me to take my medicine at 8pm.
What was the score in the Enyimba match?
How much are tomatoes in Mile 12 market?
Set a reminder for my meeting tomorrow at 10 am.
Tell me a short proverb about patience.
What is the plural of 'child' in English?
Explain what malaria is in one sentence.
ha: Nawa ne farashin shinkafa a kasuwar Kano yau?
Ina asibitin mafi kusa a Zaria?
Ka tunatar da ni in sha magani da karfe takwas na dare.
Nawa ake sayar da tumatur a kasuwar Dawanau?
Ka tuna min taron gobe da karfe goma na safe.
Fada min karin magana game da hakuri.
Ka bayyana zazzabin cizon sauro a jumla daya.
ig: Ego ole ka a na-ere osikapa n'ahịa Onitsha taa?
Ebee ka ụlọ ọgwụ dị nso n'Enugu?
Chetara m ịṅụ ọgwụ m n'elekere asatọ nke abalị.
Ego ole ka tomato dị n'ahịa Ariaria?
Chetara m nzukọ echi n'elekere iri nke ụtụtụ.
Gwa m otu ilu gbasara ndidi.
yo: Eélòó ni ìrẹsì ní ọjà Ọ̀yìngbò lónìí?
Níbo ni ilé ìwòsàn tó súnmọ́ jùlọ wà ní Ìbàdàn?
Rán mi létí láti lo oògùn mi ní agogo mẹ́jọ alẹ́.
Kí ni àbájáde ìdíje Shooting Stars?
Eélòó ni tòmátì ní ọjà Bódìjà?
Rán mi létí ìpàdé ọ̀la ní agogo mẹ́wàá òwúrọ̀.
Sọ òwe kan fún mi nípa sùúrù.
Ẹ kú ìrọ̀lẹ́, ṣé dáadáa ni?
